quotes.text: Now, when orange-flowers are distilled with water, we procure the otto of the blossom, which is known commercially as oil of neroli.
quotes.reference: 1857, G[eorge] W[illiam] Septimus Piesse, “Section III”, in The Art of Perfumery, and Method of Obtaining the Odors of Plants, […], Philadelphia, Pa.: Lindsay and Blackiston, →OCLC, page 78:
